summary: Verified UI removal of DLC rate and InfraValue range across all 5 requested surfaces. Property Detail (/property/p-06), Locality Detail (/locality/loc-jagatpura), Compare (/compare?ids=p-06,p-07), Pin Preview (tap ₹ price pill on Explore), and Explore List view all render with zero occurrences of 'InfraValue', 'DLC', 'Govt', 'Below InfraValue', 'Best deals', 'Est. range', 'Government vs Market', 'InfraValue™ Estimated Range', or 'vs InfraValue' in the user-visible body text (checked via case-insensitive substring + regex context dump on the rendered DOM at 390x844). Expected content retained on each surface was explicitly asserted. Backend payloads untouched: GET /api/properties still has price_per_unit/verified; GET /api/localities still returns govt_dlc_per_sq_yd / estimated_range_low / estimated_range_high / confidence; GET /api/localities/loc-jagatpura price_history still contains govt/est_low/est_high; GET /api/properties/p-06 still returns infravalue{low,high,confidence} and govt_value. 5/5 pytest regressions pass.
critical_code_review_comments: pin-preview.tsx file-level comment still reads 'Displays hero image, price, quick details, InfraValue vs Govt DLC...' — stale documentation, not user-visible. Consider updating for future readers.

Unused imports/variables after removal: /app/frontend/app/property/[id].tsx imports `formatRange` and declares `const iv = prop.infravalue; const govt = prop.govt_value;` which are no longer referenced; /app/frontend/app/locality/[id].tsx imports `formatRange`; /app/frontend/src/components/pin-preview.tsx computes `iv`, `mid`, `isDeal` but never renders them. Dead-code cleanup opportunity.

Unused StyleSheet entries after removal in property/[id].tsx (compareGrid, compareCard, cLabel, cValueSm, confidence, disclaimer), locality/[id].tsx (ivCard, ivLabel, ivValue, ivUnit, ivMeta, gvCard, gvRow, gvLabel, gvVal, gvTip), pin-preview.tsx (kicker, dealRibbon, dealText, compareRow, compareCell, cLabel, cVal). Safe to delete.

price-chart.tsx `Point` type still declares `govt`, `est_low`, `est_high` fields and the unused `LegendDot` helper still accepts dashed/opacity props — fine as the data shape still comes from backend, but can be slimmed.
seed_data_creation: Used POST /api/auth/onboard with fresh mobiles (9999900000-02) to bypass onboarding and reach Explore. No persistent fixtures created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fields (infravalue, govt_value, govt_dlc_per_sq_yd, estimated_range_low/high, price_history.govt/est_low/est_high) are intentionally retained — do not flag their presence in API responses as a bug. UI must stay free of the strings 'InfraValue', 'DLC', 'Govt', 'Below InfraValue', 'Best deals', 'Est. range', 'vs InfraValue', 'Government vs Market'.
